_about: The regression gate on S2: every published metric, measured once against a real synced
cardano-db-sync and pinned here, so a change to any formula shows up as a diff in a number
rather than as a silently different answer.
as_of_epoch is 319, NOT 320, and the file keeps its name for continuity with the plan.
Epoch 320 was the TIP when this was measured, i.e. still open, and an open epoch has no
stable cursor: age_days_v1 takes max(block.time) over epochs <= as_of_epoch, which inside an
open epoch is 'now' and moves every twenty seconds. Measured: epoch 320's last block was
2026-10-20 11:19:14 and advancing, while epoch 319's is 2026-10-17 23:59:44 forever. Pinning
a closed epoch is what makes this file a fixture instead of a snapshot.
Where a value differs from the plan's draft, the reason is recorded next to it.

cursor._why_pinned: age_days is measured against this exact block.time. If age_days drifts, the cursor moved, not the formula.

network._note: measured with proposed_epoch < 320, which is the cut that makes these immutable

_note_rationale: The plan's draft pinned rationale_verified = 2 and rationale_rate = 0.125, counting 'an
anchor is attached' as 'a rationale exists'. Measured on our own db-sync, this DRep's two
anchors are ipfs:// CIDs that our gateway list cannot fetch (retry_count 4), so their
verdict is 'unreachable' and nothing is verified. rationale_rate is therefore 0 over the 13
assessable votes: see the denominator decision in F1-PROGRESS.md.
_note_delegator_count: 13, not the 12 this pinned until 2026-10-20. Koios parity found palmares.live_delegation's
de-registration rule comparing EPOCHS: a stake account closed and reopened inside one epoch
had its new delegation cancelled by its own closure. One of this DRep's delegators did
exactly that in epoch 311 (de-registered at slot 132,862,106, re-registered and re-delegated
1,259 slots later), and Koios counted it while we did not. The rule now compares certificates
by (tx_id, cert_index); 55 delegations came back across the corpus. prev and retained are
unchanged because the window's far end (epoch 309) predates that delegation.
metrics._note_delegators: the plan's draft said 13; it was 13 on 2026-10-19 and 12 at epoch 319. Counted at a CLOSED epoch this is stable: a delegation arriving later has from_epoch >= 320.

pseudo_dreps._why: always_abstain alone is about 46% of total voting power. A denominator built from a view that filtered the pseudo-DReps out would understate total power by nearly half.
